test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GOOD : HSXT :: BEST : CIBJ :: COOL : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

GOOD : HSXT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a4d1bfd9091452a0b1be0ed0d464d737adeff5caa4f32b72e2f0dc50025b757.png] 

And,

BEST : CIBJ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ea99bf116fb7d47b6cb3ecb9b6859b78d8d565531959edbdaef949dc8a5495a.png] 

Similarly,

COOL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f181835256b2a01ac92013fe6f082c6f7c935a55f9946c676766bd4bcaf8f2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"DSXB".**
